content_prompt:
你是英语学习卡片的内容编辑。依据本卡目标词逐条制作内容，目标词集合必须原样保留；同一词允许复习，不新增主归属、不删除或替换目标词。不是要求所有英语句子严格仅用 Basic 850；允许必要的辅助词，但不计入850覆盖。
输出：1 场景与明确画面证据；2 每个目标词的本卡词义、词性、英美音标、自然搭配、短例句与中文、annotation_mode（object/action/relation/context）、evidence；3 图像生成提示词；4 主配文及中文，约8～18个英文词，优先自然、易懂，必要时用2～3句短对话；5 逐词覆盖检查与未完成项。
具体词标到物体，动作词标到动作，空间关系用真实对象关系或双幅对比；功能词与抽象词必须有包含该词或明确屈折形式的自然句子和语境，不给虚假的物体框。所有目标词都有独立可查的词条，即使主配文没有包含它。语法词在词句中高亮，不把冠词标成物体。
主配文草案均为原创，不冒充名著或名言。若要求文学配文，先找可核实的原文，提供作者、作品、原文位置、来源URL及使用依据。不得只根据作者去世就断言可商用；单独核查英文原文、所选版本和译文。改写必须标记 adaptation，原创译文标记 original_translation。查不到出处就使用原创句。无需每张都放名言，更不硬凑所有目标词到一条名言里。
音标和释义需按本卡词义重新核对，不能把源仓库的未经复核数据当成成品。坐标仅在最终图生成后设置；现在可给位置建议，不声称已有精确框选。输出status=content_draft，图片完成并逐词核对后才能改为approved。

标题 窗前的昼夜

目标词 window, day, night, bright, dark, sun, moon, star

image_prompt: Generate a refined editorial photograph, portrait 4:5, two equal vertical panels with a very thin clean divider. A photographic day/night diptych showing exactly the same large tall window in a quiet minimalist Korean boutique apartment, same camera position and same adult East Asian woman about 25, pearl ivory cardigan and pale grey skirt, loose low hair bun, understated cool makeup and real skin texture. LEFT PANEL DAY: crisp cool white daylight, bright interior, clear blue sky with a small realistically sized visible sun high through the window, landscape below. RIGHT PANEL NIGHT: the identical window and room, dark navy night sky, a clearly recognizable slender crescent moon and a few small discrete natural stars visible through the glass, softly dim interior; moon and stars not reflections or stickers. The woman is seated quietly beside the lower part of the window in both panels, beautifully composed environmental fashion portrait, window frame is clearly identifiable, sky occupies generous upper window area for later precise annotation. High end Instagram Korean cool editorial photography, restrained pearl white mist grey muted blue palette, natural complexion, subtle editorial retouch preserving skin pores hair and fabric, no plastic skin, no CGI, believable anatomy and perspective. Keep all sun/moon/stars completely inside their respective visible sky panels and make them easy to find. No text, letters, numbers, labels, speech bubbles, brands, watermarks or UI. This is a photographic comparison, not a fantasy composite. Both panels are separate moments; no sun in the night panel and no moon in the day panel.

image_review.summary: 同窗同人物昼夜双幅；左幅太阳圆盘、右幅新月与独立星点可辨；室内亮度有明确差异。成年年轻女性、冷调精修，人物结构自然。无可读标注和水印。
